cards.mood: The piece opens with an ethereal and mysterious atmosphere that quickly gives way to aggressive, high-energy tension upon the entry of the full band.
cards.palette: Heavily distorted electric guitars serve as the core harmonic and rhythmic engine, playing palm-muted chugging riffs in the verses and open, soaring power chords in the choruses.
